notes.title: Bug Patch #2
notes.notes:
Hey all,

This week we've got another small Friday update (build #1639667) with a few changes.

Bug Fixes and Improvements

Added an option to toggle VSync from the options menu (this might help the performance/stuttering issues some of you have still been reporting).
Fixed a bug with mouse acceleration introduced from Bug Patch #1
Fixed a bug when using Alt+Enter (Cmd+F on Mac) to enter full screen mode where the UI/HUD would disappear.
Updated our Steamworks SDK (this should be a transparent change, but if you see any issues with achievements or leaderboards, let us know).


Set Target Frame Rate
We've also added an in-game console command to help those with performance issues. You can set the target frame rate (from 30-120). For example, if your machine is less powerful it might be a better experience to clamp the frame rate to 30.
[olist]
Open Poi and hit the tilde (~) key (left of the 1 key).
Type: "targetfps [num]" (no quotes and replace [num] with the desired fps). For example: targetfps 30
Hit (~) again to close the console.
[/olist]

You can also use the "fps" console command to display the frame rate in the lower left corner of the screen to verify.

We're continuing to work on bugs, performance and other things so please keep the feedback coming.

Happy weekend!

-The PolyKid Team

notes.title: Retro-inspired 3D platformer Poi release date set
notes.notes:
PolyKid's Poi is a lovely-looking '90s-esque whimsical 3D platformer that echoes the likes of Spyro, Banjo-Kazooie, and, going back further still, Bubsy. As Tom Sykes previously reported, it debuted on Steam's Early Access programme in November 2015 however is now ready to bolt from its stable into the realm of full release. Come February 1, a week from today, Poi will launch its version 1.0.A self-proclaimed "love letter to the '90s era of classic platforming titles", Poi follows two adventurous kids as they set off on an quest in a strange whale-shaped airship to learn more about the 'Milky Way Globe' while gathering 'Explorer Medallions'. Obviously.With "tight, precise controls with all the platforming moves you know and love", this sees the intrepid pair conversing with a cast of bubbly genre-typical characters and battling a host of similarly discernible baddies.Over to Poi's launch trailer to depict some of that in practice: 

Admittedly, I'm a sucker for both nostalgia and this style of game—but what about that soundtrack? It comes courtesy of Virginia composer Lyndon Holland. Before you go, I thought I'd share this Dragon Quest-like enemy concept artwork PolyKid posted via an update last year. It's pretty cool:

Poi is due February 1.

notes.title: Update #7 - Enemies & Friends
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

Today we launch our BIGGEST update yet. There is so much new stuff to check out, so let's get straight to it!

Improved Story & Flow
We've tweaked character dialog and the overall game flow in order to tell a better story and make the whole experience feel much better. We encourage people to try out a new save file to get the full experience! There may even be a hint of what's to come if you play through again...

50+ Explorer Medallions
We've added a 7th Explorer Medallion to each level, as well as others throughout the game. There are now over 50 medallions to collect!

Enemies have invaded
Be careful out there. We've added nine enemy types to the game.

New Friends
Each level now has a friendly race of creatures to meet. 

Player Voices
We've added character voices to the game. Special thanks to Tamara Ryan, Chris Thurman and Michael Sheleman for lending their voices to the game.

Mount Magma Overhaul
Some of the objectives in Mount Magma have been completely redone due to the Buckethead invasion.

Sky Overhaul
There is a ton of new stuff to see in the Sky as you play through the game. Friends that you meet in the levels will appear, new events will happen, and maybe a secret or two will show up...

New Challenge Levels
We added five new challenge levels, so be sure to save up and check them out.

Fossil and Location Rewards
Finding all the fossils and locations will now net you some cool rewards, so be sure to explore every nook and cranny for them.

Explorer Book and UI Update
The UI and Explorer Book have a new and improved look.

New Shop Items
We've removed the "coming soon" items to free up space for two new items: the coin magnet and extra heart container.

Revised Death Flow
Falling off a level now decrements your heart count by one instead of insta-death (so it's easier to hold on to your coins). We've also added a new death screen when all your hearts have been lost.

Improved Camera
The camera should be much smoother now and no longer go through walls.

No more Explorer XP and Explorer Level
Everything is now based off how many Explorer Medallions you have. We think this makes unlocking progress simpler to understand and feels better overall.

True 60 FPS
We investigated an issue brought up by qaopjlll on our forums and found that the game was rendering at 60 FPS, but our physics was only updating at 50 FPS. We've made some changes and now everything runs at a true 60 FPS. You should notice the game to look a lot smoother!

And more!

Various gameplay improvements to the Forest
A tall man with a beard has been spotted in Mount Magma.
The Astronomer in Cozy Canyon will now visit you in the Sky if you help him out.
New player animations and effects
Lots of bug fixes
Additional SFX and Music


We've still got a lot left to do, but we hope you all enjoy this latest update! Please let us know if you see any bugs and share your comments and feedback on our forums. And THANK YOU to all our early access players. Your support is what keeps us going!

-Ben & Paul
PolyKid

notes.title: Update #3 - Linux + SteamOS
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

We wanted to get a small Friday update (build id #895853) out this week with Linux + SteamOS support! We heard you asking for it, so now those of you with Steam Machines can enjoy Poi from your living rooms, too.

Poi running on Ubuntu Linux



Bug Fixes / Tweaks


Fixed a bug where the back button didn't work correctly on Windows.
New player sprint animation (work in progress).
Minor Cozy Canyon & Mount Magma level adjustments.


Medallion "Return to Hub" Feedback
We also wanted to address feedback regarding the forced return to hub flow after collecting a medallion. We realize Cozy Canyon and Mount Magma didn't change at all based on which medallion you select, but that's something we always wanted to add. So for this update, we modified those levels a little based on which medallion you pick from the level select screen. Right now the changes are relatively small, but we hope to expand upon this system going forward.

We're still looking into persisting more data between level loads (ie, the 7 Lost Keys), but overall we feel this direction gives us more creative freedom (for current and future levels) to make each medallion feel more unique.

Of course this is a work in progress and we appreciate everyone's feedback, so please let us know what you think!

Have a great weekend everyone!

notes.title: Update #2 - Mac, Save Profiles, Additional Leaderboards and Bugs!
notes.notes:
This week's update brings OS X support, save profiles, additional leaderboards for all medallions and a bunch of bug fixes & improvements.



We're still hard at work on more levels and content, but we wanted to get these important changes out first. The full list is detailed below:

Update #2 (build id 884894)

New Features / Tweaks

Added multiple save profiles from the main menu.
Added global leaderboards for all medallions.
Display medallion times in the Explorer Book.
Display the current level timer in the pause menu.
Prevent accidental cutscene skips by showing "Press A to Skip".
Mapped keyboard arrow keys to rotate the camera.
Re-mapped the close parachute keyboard key from 'B' to 'R'.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where restarting levels didn't reset the level timer.
Fixed occasional mouse cursor flicker.
Fixed rendering artifacts with UI text caused by different resolutions.
Fixed camera pop after initial cutscene in the forest.
Fixed input bug when selecting UI elements (sometimes it would skip over a selection)
Fixed a bug where the resolution drop-down list could extend off screen (on 4k monitors).
Fixed a bug where the HUD timer could overlap the pause menu.
Fixed a bug where fossil & location UI popups could overlap.
Fixed a rendering bug with the telescope UI on low-quality mode.
Fixed a bug where input was still being processed after selecting UI elements.
Fixed a bug where UI hints would flicker between keyboard and controller images.
Fixed a bug where you could interact with NPCs while having an item equipped.
Fixed a bug where player particles weren't getting cleaned up on level reset, causing long white particle trails.
Player avatar resets properly when deleting save data.
Removed floating grass in the forest.
Disabled auto-rotate camera zones when playing with mouse/keyboard.

Shoutouts

A World of Platforming Adventure - Hardcore Gamer

Additional Notes

Previously obtained medallion times won't automatically upload to the new steam leaderboards because we had some unfair timer exploits in older builds.
Upgraded from Unity 4.3 to 4.6.9 (for added stability).


Please let us know what you think of this update on our forums.

Thanks again for your support everyone!

notes.title: Update #1 (855245)
notes.notes:
Our first update!

We want to give a huge THANK YOU to everyone who's participated in our Early Access so far. And especially those who have reported bugs in our Technical Support forums. This build focuses on fixing a lot of bugs and adding a few new features / tweaks to make the overall experience better.

New Features / Tweaks

Temporary invincibility granted when the player touches lava.
Disabled player lives until further balancing can be done.
Added a "Reset Local Leaderboards" button in the options menu.
Added a "Camera Momentum" slider in the options menu.
Changed tutorial text for the Explorer Book to better explain how to open the Explorer Book.
Balanced the Shovel so that coins can't be infinitely farmed in a single spot.
Added a restart button to the pause menu for all levels (not just for challenge levels).
Borderless window mode added (enter -popupwindow as a launch option in Steam).


Bug Fixes

Resetting the level while in over the shoulder mode allowed for "flying."
The [spoiler]Lavasaurus Rex[/spoiler] fossil was not diggable / dissappeared in Mount Magma.
Challenge levels did not reset to their original state when restarted.
The Big Spender achievement was broken. Everyone who bought an item should now get the achievement after starting up the new build.
Fixed various lightmap issues in Mount Magma.
Fixed lighting issues with the player's mouth and the Girl's eyes.
Falling rocks in Mount Magma did not have a shadow.
Using the shovel while performing a side flip allowed the player to move around while in the dig animation.
Standing on a floating island near the player boundary in the Sky caused a massive force to be applied the next time the Explorer's Sail was used.
Falling off the [spoiler]Moon[/spoiler] caused the game timer to reset and allowed for unrealistic completion times for that Explorer Medallion.
The Telescope now works better with inverted control options.
The [spoiler]Runaway Fox[/spoiler] footprints in Cozy Canyon were not being cleaned up properly.
The player can no longer move during the fade out when "Return To Sky" option is selected from the pause menu.
Sometimes coins on the [spoiler]Moon[/spoiler] were not collectible.
The [spoiler]bird[/spoiler] in Cozy Canyon now has the right texture.
Disabled over the shoulder while looking through the Telescope.


Global Leaderboard Changes

We've introduced a global leaderboard version system for our challenge levels. 
Since we fixed some big challenge level glitches in this build, there are new leaderboards. If you do not update the game to this build, you can still post times to the old leaderboards, but they will only be visible to people still on the old build. 
We don't plan on adding a new leaderboard version for every update--only when necessary and with as much advance warning as possible.


If you have any questions, please leave us a comment or make a post over in our forums. Happy exploring!
